newsitem.title: USA: Global completes 2.9 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Global completes 2.9 mln shr offering.

text.p: Global Telecommunication Solutions Inc said Tuesday that it has successfully completed the sale of 2,875,000 shares of its common stock at $5.50 per share, for a total of $15,812,500.
GKN Securities Corp and Barington Capital Group LP acted as underwriters.

The shares were trading Tuesday afternoon at 6-1/2. Global Telecommunication offers traditional and custom-designed prepaid phone cards for business promotional use and for specialized purposes, such as information access and interactive games.
